name: Omatranslate
author: kartabas
description: Translate the passage you highlight in a PDF, right where you are reading — then keep the session as Markdown.

barWidget.description: Highlight-to-translate in the background, with quick access to the session window and Settings.

schema.label: Watch for highlights
schema.description: Run Omatranslate in the background. A highlight then shows a Translate chip; nothing is translated until you press it.
